visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair and a white tank top stands against a plain olive-green wall, smiling broadly and speaking enthusiastically into the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a pink box of 'fwee Blurry Pudding Pot' placed on a pink silk background decorated with pearls and small spheres. (3) The woman holds up three small makeup boxes, then proceeds to unbox a pink one, revealing a small round jar with a matte lid. (4) A product display shows a pink keyring container opening to reveal a mirror inside. (5) The woman swatches the pink pudding-like product on her palm, blending it with her finger to demonstrate its soft, matte texture. (6) She applies the pink color to her lips with her fingertip while looking into the camera. (7) She introduces a blue-capped jar, swatches a purplish-pink shade on her hand, and applies it to her lips, comparing the colors. (8) A silver highlighter compact is shown on a blue glittery background. She swatches it on her forearm, revealing a strong iridescent purple-white shimmer. (9) She applies the highlighter to her nose and cheeks, showing a surprised, excited facial expression. (10) She unboxes a red 'Honey Peach' jelly product, demonstrating its bouncy texture by tapping it with her finger before layering it over her lip color. (11) She applies a liquid lip tint from a small pink bottle, looking slightly skeptical of the subtle color payoff. (12) A final product, a small round eyeshadow palette with five shades, is shown. She swatches all five colors on her arm in sequence. (13) She applies the glittery eyeshadow to her eyelids and gives a final wave to the camera.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with long dark brown hair, wearing a white sleeveless tank top, with clean-look makeup.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched female voice speaks enthusiastically in Traditional Chinese over a cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic guitar BGM. (2) Frequent 'pop' and 'whoosh' sound effects accompany visual scene transitions and the appearance of text. (3) During unboxing, faint rustling of cardboard is heard. The woman's voice remains dominant and energetic. (4) A 'ding' sound effect triggers as product details are highlighted on screen. (5) Vocal reactions like 'Wow' and 'Oh' are clear and high in arousal, synchronized with swatching demonstrations. (6) A shimmering chime SFX is audible when showing the iridescent highlighter. (7) Percussive tapping sounds occur as the woman demonstrates the bouncy jelly product texture. (8) The audio mix is clean and professionally mastered, with music consistently ducked under the clear narration.
